normalization_rule.session_date: parse timezone-aware timestamp and convert to America/New_York before deriving the session date
normalization_rule.conflict_policy: fail closed if canonical duplicates disagree on any OHLCV field

prior_close_pairing.warning: Adjacent rows are not automatically adjacent exchange sessions; the future test must require the prior date to be the immediately previous SPY/NYSE session for the symbol.

lifecycle_metadata.future_join_rule: Use provider-asset identity and valid_from/valid_to at every decision date; do not use current_status as a historical eligibility shortcut.

corporate_actions.signal_rule: Use the split-adjusted price series for the price-component signal; do not add dividend cash to the signal. Apply any explicit dividend cash flow exactly once only in the later P&L experiment.

split_discontinuity_qc.material_split_factor_definition: absolute price factor difference greater than 10 percent
split_discontinuity_qc.interpretation: Structural basis QC only. The zero count supports that material split factors were not left as raw price jumps. Final authority is the provider split-adjusted manifest plus src/parayabuck/data/adjustment.py and the product loader's refusal to apply split actions again.

regular_session_and_feed.timestamp_rule: NYSE session date derived in America/New_York; holidays and missing symbol sessions are handled by an explicit common-session join.
regular_session_and_feed.daily_open_semantics: Provider daily open is the first qualifying regular-sale trade included in the consolidated bar; it is not asserted to equal the official exchange opening-auction clearing price.

future_test_prerequisites: Materialize the deterministic alias-normalized 1d view and fail closed on canonical conflicts.
Join signal rows to the immediately previous common SPY/NYSE session, not merely the prior row.
Join each symbol to point-in-time lifecycle intervals before scanner eligibility.
Use split-adjusted OHLC without split-action application; keep dividend cash handling separate and single-counted.
Use next-tradable-open fills and label them as provider-open proxy fills.
Stop the common-period evaluation at 2026-07-30 unless SPY coverage is explicitly extended.
